submitted.rationale: Out of the three compositions measured, index 14 (Cr0.52Sb0.48) had the highest EQE, 0.0269%. That is near the CrSbO4 rutile stoichiometry. Index 9 (Cr0.67) came in almost the same at 0.0268%. Index 23, on the Sb-rich side, was much lower at 0.0096%. XRD shows rutile (Q≈1.93) in all three scanned films. There is also a Cr2O3-like peak (Q≈2.55) at the Cr-rich end (index 5) and a rutile/Sb-oxide mixture at the Sb-rich end. Merit appears to peak somewhere in the Cr 0.5–0.7 range.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE of 0.0096%, about 3x lower than index 14 (Sb-rich side)
Measured EQE of 0.0268%, essentially tied with index 14 but slightly lower
XRD at index 5 suggests a Cr2O3 secondary phase. It was not measured for merit because the budget ran out.
